basic_details.job_title: PDKV Assistant Manager Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Krishi Vidyapeeth (Dr. PDKV), Akola has 1 purely contractual Assistant Manager post under its "RKVY-RAFTAAR" Agri Business Incubator (R-ABI) project. Applications in the prescribed proforma must reach the Agri-Business Incubation Centre (R-ABI), Dr. PDKV, Akola on or before 29 October 2026. Shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview.

important_dates.interview_date: To be sent to shortlisted candidates by e-mail
important_dates.contract ends (at the latest): 31/03/2027, or the end of the project if that is earlier

qualification.details: Educational qualification: M.Tech/MBA/CA/PGDM/Equivalent Master Degree in Agri-Business/ Finance/Commerce/Marketing/Agri. Marketing/AgriEconomics/Economics/ Technology Commercialization/ Entrepreneurship from a recognized institute. Experience: relevant experience of 3-5 years. Preferred experience: technology commercialization; Investment banking; Banking; Project appraisal, support incubators; Assessment and evaluation of projects startups; and experience in the startup ecosystem. Age limit: maximum 50 years for SC/ST/OBC/OPEN candidates. The application proforma asks for your age as on 31 October 2026. Pay: a consolidated amount of Rs. 0.70 lakh per month. *If a candidate does not have the required qualification or has less experience than required, the salary offered may be adjusted to the level of qualification and experience shown, as the hiring authority/committee decides. Nature and length of the appointment: the appointment lasts as long as the project or up to 31 March 2027, whichever is earlier. It is purely temporary and contractual and may be ended at any time. The engagement is on a purely temporary, ad hoc basis, approved by the competent authority of Dr. PDKV, Akola. Leave and service claim: the technical manpower does not have the status of regular employees, so they are not entitled to any regular leave. The candidate cannot claim continued service or a place in the regular establishment of Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Krishi Vidyapeeth, Akola. | Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

selection_process: Shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview. The date and venue of the interview will be sent to them by e-mail only. Candidates must report at the institute one hour before the scheduled date and time
with all documents in original for verification. The selection committee's decision will be final and binding in all respects.
Candidates called for the interview must bring:
A detailed biodata with a recent passport-size photograph affixed Self-attested photocopies of certificates supporting their age
testimonials and other credentials All original experience certificates and testimonials supporting their age
important_instructions: Applications without supporting documents, and applications not in the specified format, will be rejected. Incomplete forms will be rejected, and all documentary evidence should be readable and clear. No T.A./D.A. will be paid for attending the interview. Canvassing in any form is liable to disqualify the candidate. The selected candidate must sign a contract bond of Rs.100/- before joining and must follow the terms and conditions of the contract. The selected candidate must join within 10 days from the date the order is issued; otherwise the order will be treated as cancelled. At joining, the candidate must show all original documents to the concerned officer: Date of Birth, Educational Qualifications (SSC and above), experience certificate, and a no objection certificate if employed. A medical fitness certificate from the Civil Surgeon must be produced within 15 days from the date of joining. The Principal Investigator of the scheme can end the engagement without notice for unsatisfactory work or any other valid reason. The engagement also ends if the project closes or the position is abolished. To leave or resign before the tenure ends, the candidate must give one month's notice, or pay one month's pay (or pay for the period by which the notice falls short). If the project continues, the Principal Investigator alone decides whether the position is re-advertised or continued. Updates will appear on the website.

content_sections.heading: About PDKV Assistant Manager
content_sections.text: Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Krishi Vidyapeeth is an agricultural university in Krishi Nagar, Akola, Maharashtra. The Assistant Manager post belongs to the Agri-Business Incubation Centre (R-ABI), which the university runs under the "RKVY-RAFTAAR" Agri Business Incubator project. The centre is headed by the Managing Director (NG-AIF), Next Gen Agri Innovation Foundation, and a Principal Investigator runs the project.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Fill in the Application Proforma for the post of Assistant Manager, which is printed with the notice. Send it to: R-ABI, Agri-Business Incubation Centre, Near Shahid Stambh, Opposite to Vice Chancellor office, Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Krishi Vidyapeeth (M.S.), Akola- 444 104. It must reach the centre on or before 29 October 2026. The proforma is addressed to the Principal Investigator & Managing Director (NG-AIF), Agri-Business Incubation Centre, Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Krishi Vidyapeeth, Akola. The notice does not say what to write on the envelope or which postal service to use. Affix a recent passport-size photograph in the box on the proforma. Complete the subject line: "Application for the post of ... under project Next Gen "RKVY-RAFTAAR Agri Business Incubation Centre (R-ABI)", writing the post name in the blank. Fill in your name (surname first), date of birth (in figures and words), age as on 31/10/2026, gender, caste, category, correspondence address with PIN code, mobile number and e-mail address. Enter your educational qualifications (SSC, HSC, Graduation, Post Graduation, NET and any additional qualification required for the job), with the board/university, year of passing, percentage, class and subject. Add any award or medal and any fellowship or scholarship related to incubation or startups. Also add publications relevant to Business Development or the Startup ecosystem. List your experience relevant to business development or startups (employer, post held, pay scale, from and up to dates, total experience in years). Then add any IP, incubation or other relevant experience and your significant achievements in industrial development, entrepreneurship development or startups. Sign the declaration with the date and place, and attach self-attested copies of all supporting documents.

Nature and length of the appointment: the appointment lasts as long as the project or up to 31 March 2027, whichever is earlier. It is purely temporary and contractual and may be ended at any time. The engagement is on a purely temporary, ad hoc basis, approved by the competent authority of Dr. PDKV, Akola. Leave and service claim: the technical manpower does not have the status of regular employees, so they are not entitled to any regular leave. The candidate cannot claim continued service or a place in the regular establishment of Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Krishi Vidyapeeth, Akola. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in PDKV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for the post of Assistant Manager under the RKVY-RAFTAAR Agri Business Incubator (R-ABI) project at Dr. PDKV, Akola.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date for the PDKV Assistant Manager application?
faq.answer: The application must reach the Agri-Business Incubation Centre (R-ABI), Dr. PDKV, Akola on or before 29 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the PDKV Assistant Manager post?
faq.answer: You need an M.Tech/MBA/CA/PGDM/Equivalent Master Degree in Agri-Business/ Finance/Commerce/Marketing/Agri. Marketing/AgriEconomics/Economics/ Technology Commercialization/ Entrepreneurship from a recognized institute. You also need 3-5 years of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the PDKV Assistant Manager post?
faq.answer: The age limit is a maximum of 50 years for SC/ST/OBC/OPEN candidates. The application proforma asks for your age as on 31 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the PDKV Assistant Manager?
faq.answer: The post pays a consolidated Rs. 0.70 lakh per month. The salary may be adjusted if a candidate has less than the required qualification or experience.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the PDKV Assistant Manager post?
faq.answer: Fill in the prescribed Application Proforma and attach self-attested copies of all supporting documents. Send it to R-ABI, Agri-Business Incubation Centre, Near Shahid Stambh, Opposite to Vice Chancellor office, Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Krishi Vidyapeeth (M.S.), Akola- 444 104, so that it reaches by 29 October 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the PDKV Assistant Manager post?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview. The date and venue will be sent by e-mail only, and candidates must report one hour early with all original documents.

faq.question: Q8. Is the PDKV Assistant Manager post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The post is purely temporary and contractual. It lasts as long as the project or up to 31 March 2027, whichever is earlier, and gives no claim to a regular post at Dr. PDKV, Akola.

faq.question: Q9. Will TA/DA be paid for the PDKV Assistant Manager interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no T.A./D.A. will be paid for appearing in the interview.

faq.question: Q10. Do government employees need an NOC to apply?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates already working in a Govt. Organisation should produce a "No Objection Certificate" from their present employer.
